source: authenticated GraphQL PR bodies, linked issues, labels, and changed paths

rules.bug: A defect fix with a closing or explicitly referenced issue; feature requests and unlinked fixes are excluded.
rules.perf: Performance or resource use is the primary effect, supported by benchmarks, a performance news fragment, or equivalent runtime evidence.
rules.documentation: The PR changes at least one real docs/**/*.md or docs/**/*.mdx file; changelog fragments alone do not qualify.
rules.breaking: The PR removes or changes a current supported API or compatibility contract; template boilerplate alone does not qualify.

special_evidence: #7446 and #7447 both reference issue #7444 and fix the same retained state-tree memory cost; both qualify as bug and perf while their duplicate status is handled separately by the board.
#7436 references issue #7253, adds regression coverage, and carries a performance fragment for eliminating redundant hydrated-value deltas.

#7360 fixes the ENG-12909 request-cookie privacy defect; #7381 fixes #7190 while tightening mixin declarations; #7399 fixes #7391 while removing exported frontend helpers.
#7449 changes docs/getting_started/installation.md, so it receives documentation; the current change only warns on Python 3.10 and does not yet break support, so it is not labeled breaking.
#7408 uses a conventional breaking-change title and changes Plotly.js compatibility while preserving a deprecated bridge for rx.plotly.mapbox.

#7313 removes StateProxy APIs, #7338 changes the StateManager contract, #7381 rejects formerly accepted clashing mixin declarations, #7360 removes request-cookie exposure from frontend router state, #7399 removes exported frontend helpers, and #7040 hard-switches the supported HTTP client dependency.

PRs with bug-fix language but no associated issue are not labeled bug under the requested rule.
